featured_reviews.review_text:

She does a lot of variations & flavours, she tops the tart with Berries, strawberries, mango, etc, but my favourite is the original one with hazelnuts. I usually buy this cake for any and every occasion and fortunately my friends, family, work folks all have loved it so much that repeating this cake only creates excitement. I think there are times when we end up celebrating the cake instead of the occasion itself 😜. The mousse, the consistency of the tart its so yum and melts in the mouth. Just the thought of it  makes my mouth water. Annie's Jar's are also to die for. When there is no occasion and I want to casually take something to a visitor's house I do the Cake jars and that's a fantastic hit as well... I have so many friends who ask me to specially get the tart from Annie & only Annie, it's magic, I'm telling you it goes to the heart. If you haven't tried it as yet, arghh pls do yourself a favour and order one now. While Annie has been kind to me, if you plan to order a cake from her, please order in advance, her slots get full very fast!
Thanks Annie for always accomodating me and giving me your best cakes to relish! ❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of trying cakes from Hangout Cakes & More, and I must say, it was an unforgettable experience! This charming little bakery truly knows how to marry creativity with flavor, resulting in some of the most delicious cakes I’ve ever tasted.

Presentation:
From the moment I laid eyes on the cakes, I was captivated. Each cake was a work of art, beautifully designed with intricate details and vibrant colors. Whether it was the classic chocolate ganache or the trendy floral buttercream designs, the visual appeal alone made it difficult to choose!

Flavors:
Now, let’s talk about the taste! I opted for a slice of their signature red velvet cake and a piece of the rich chocolate mousse. The red velvet was moist with just the right amount of tanginess, complemented perfectly by the creamy cream cheese frosting that had a delightful hint of vanilla. The chocolate mousse, on the other hand, was a dream for any chocolate lover—smooth, decadent, and not overly sweet, it left me craving more.

Variety:
Hangout Cakes & More offers an impressive variety of flavors, catering to all palates. Whether you’re in the mood for fruity, nutty, or indulgently rich, you’re sure to find something that suits your taste. They also have options for dietary restrictions, including gluten-free and vegan cakes, which I truly appreciate.

Service:
The service at Hangout Cakes & More is exceptional. The staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and eager to help you choose the perfect cake for any occasion. They genuinely care about their customers and take the time to make personalized recommendations based on your preferences.

Overall Experience:
Overall, my experience at Hangout Cakes & More was delightful from start to finish. The combination of stunning designs, mouthwatering flavors, and exceptional service makes this bakery a must-visit. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or simply treating yourself, their cakes are sure to impress. I can't wait to return and try more flavors—highly recommend!

featured_reviews.review_text:
A tidy and well kept café in the heart of the Fort area. It is relatively quiet for the location, which makes it a comfortable place to sit rather than just grab and go.

Coffee was acceptable rather than memorable. The cappuccino and Americano did the job without standing out. The pastry selection was uneven. The dark chocolate mousse pastry was well done and rich, the Dutch truffles pastry was ordinary, while the fresh cream pineapple pastry was genuinely good.

One moment felt slightly awkward. At the counter, the cashier suggested he could lower the bill by around Rs 12 by entering a different coffee option into the system, and asked whether I would prefer that. I am sure the intention was to be helpful, but it came across as unnecessary and a little uncomfortable.

Overall, a decent stop for pastries & coffee in Fort.

featured_reviews.review_text:
This cute dessert parlour is located in Matunga East. Their menu includes everything delicious, ranging from waffles to shakes to ice-creams and colourful pastries.

I tried their famous Charcoal black cold stone ice-cream and it was absolutely drool-worthy. Subtle hints of coconut in chocolate is exactly what you'll find in every bite. Its a must try.

With the strawberry season on in full swing, why not indulge in some of their strawberry delicacies?

The cocoberry waffle contains fresh strawberry pieces and oodles of chocolate sauce on top of a crisp, golden brown waffle. Need I say anymore?

And my favourite was the Mahabaleshwar and cream. A blend of smooth and creamy whipped cream with strawberry sauce and crunchy pieces of strawberry. This dessert surely celebrates the strawberry season. Its totally delicious and heavenly!

And finally, their oreo madness shake is filled with the goodness of crushed oreos, chocolate sauce and milk. Could have been a wee bit thicker.

A lovely place to satisfy your dessert cravings. Do visit!

I tried the special mango menu there in which i tried :
1) Mango Maharaja : It consisted The tasty and cold Mango Icecream , Vanilla Whipped Cream and The king of all fruits : Mango pieces. It was layered beautifully and tasted very well . It was the first thing i tried and felt very tasty so tried many other mango items there.

2) Choco Mango waffle : Made with perfection it consisted the crispy waffle , having the layer of nutella chocolate and over it were the mango pieces! The taste of mango pieces was going perfectly with the nutella chocolate.

3) Mango Shake : The taste of the mango shake was not too sweet . It tasted really like a pure mango milkshake made with mangoes.

4) Mango popsicle : It was made of the Mango icecream and for the toppings there were many options, first i selected the layer of dark chocolate (there were 2 options : dark chocolate or white chocolate) then in toppings i seleced
i) Red velvet crush of the cube ii) Cadbury gems iii) White choco chips
And finally after the toppings there was a sweet white chocolate drizzle which made it look attractive

5)Mango detox icecream with rainbow cone: The Scoop of Mango detox icecream was good and was above expectations
The cone had a good crisp and was multicoloured

6) Banarasiya Paan shake : The Banarasiya Paan shake which is named perfectly with its taste . It was made with perfection but but i felt it a little more weet then expected.

Oasiss Desserts is your one stop destination for some awesome desserts.

featured_reviews.name: Nirmala Gangoly
featured_reviews.review_text:
A Hidden Gem – Ellipsis Bakery

Ellipsis Bakery is one of those delightful places that feels like a discovery. Tucked away from the main street and hidden in a quiet corner, it offers a warm, inviting atmosphere and an impressive range of wholesome, delicious food.

The menu is extensive, with something for every taste. From pastas, sandwiches, bagels, and burgers to fresh salads, wraps, and rolls, everything is thoughtfully prepared. The fillings are generous and flavorful, featuring ingredients such as eggs, chicken, and turkey. While they don't serve pork or mutton, the variety available is more than enough to satisfy.

The desserts deserve special mention. We tried the apple pie served with vanilla ice cream, and it was outstanding. The pie was beautifully made, and the vanilla ice cream tasted authentic and rich—a perfect combination.

What makes Ellipsis Bakery even more special is that it's not just a café but also a bakery and specialty store. Before leaving, you can browse an excellent selection of freshly baked breads, including sourdough, as well as a wide variety of healthy cookies made with ingredients such as millets, almonds, and oats. It's hard to resist taking some home.

The quality, variety, and attention to detail make Ellipsis Bakery a truly charming destination. Whether you're looking for a hearty meal, a sweet treat, or artisanal baked goods, this hidden gem is well worth seeking out.
